newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil IBGE reduces estimate of 1997 planted area.
newsitem.headline: Brazil IBGE reduces estimate of 1997 planted area.

text.p: Planted area for Brazil's 1997 grains and oilseeds harvest in key states should reach 27.34 million hectares, the National Statistics Institute (IBGE) said in its second estimate.
This is below the 27.48 million hectares estimated last month and also 1.06 percent less than the 27.63 million hectares planted in 1996.

It would however represent a 0.19 percent increase on harvested area last year of 27.29 million hectares after many sowings were lost in a prolonged drought in the south which resulted in lower production than had been expected.
The IBGE made its 1997 forecast for planted area after a second field survey in the southern, southeastern, and center-west regions as well as in the state of Rondonia.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
